description: On the green-covered surface, there’s a small clear plastic food container with a separate clear lid, a dark-rimmed lid piece nearby, and a small pink item in between. The left hand steadies the open container while the right hand picks up the pink item and places it inside, then the right hand brings the lid over the top and presses down as the left hand holds the base, closing the container into a two-hand object before both hands ease their grip.
